component.name: Lituus
component.summary: Settings for Hyprland and other desktops

description.p: The settings app for Linux desktops that don't come with one, such as Hyprland. It drives the services you already have, so their own tools keep working alongside it.

ul.li: Network, through NetworkManager: Wi-Fi, wired, WireGuard, OpenVPN and Cisco AnyConnect (with NetworkManager's OpenConnect plugin), a hotspot, and every connection setting
Bluetooth, through BlueZ: pairing, devices, headset audio, files and a phone's internet
Sound, through PipeWire: outputs, inputs, a volume per app, and sound cards' profiles
Displays, through Hyprland: the layout, modes, scale, HDR, workspaces and profiles that switch on hotplug
Input, through Hyprland: keyboard layouts and key repeat, mice and touchpads, and your shortcuts
Wallpaper, through awww or hyprpaper: pictures from a folder on each monitor, transitions and a slideshow
Apps and default apps: what your launcher shows and how each app starts, and which app opens links, each kind of file and the terminal
System: hardware, storage, package updates and the computer's name
Colours from your wallpaper (matugen), or built-in themes
